status: Passed six core browser workflows and a targeted selected-budget visual follow-up on the final build
scope: Optional short listen/speak practice with original scenes, saved first comprehension responses, self-assessed changed-detail retelling and a later-day fresh response.
method: Design review and reproducible synthetic learner workflows. No empirical learner study, retention experiment or pronunciation evaluation.

requirementsReview.concern: Text exposure must remain visible in the evidence after reload.
requirementsReview.acceptance: Transcript/translation or model exposure is persisted as support for subsequent gist/detail responses in that run. Audio replay alone is not labelled text support. First checked outcomes are immutable.

requirementsReview.concern: Scene metadata and gist feedback can accidentally disclose later answers.
requirementsReview.acceptance: Titles and introductions do not supply the gist answer before listening; gist feedback does not reveal the still-unanswered detail answer.

requirementsReview.concern: A reading fallback or successful multiple-choice response is narrower evidence than listening competence.
requirementsReview.acceptance: Device TTS and fallback reading are labelled. Reading requires explicit text reveal. UI reports first comprehension responses without recorded text support, with no independent-listening, fluency or CEFR claim.

requirementsReview.concern: Retelling and delayed prompts can be mistaken for graded speaking or demonstrated improvement.
requirementsReview.acceptance: Retelling and the fresh later-day response remain explicitly self-assessed. The later response is separate evidence; neither same-day correction nor return alone establishes delayed improvement.

requirementsReview.concern: An optional timed choice should not overwrite the learner’s ongoing course.
requirementsReview.acceptance: Five/ten minute choices are estimates for a pinned run. Existing plan, core progress, active programme and XP do not change. Old sparse version1 backups remain usable.

requirementsReview.concern: Local backup handling must preserve first evidence without persisting recordings or raw source payloads.
requirementsReview.acceptance: Export retains authored-run evidence and drafts. Merge preserves whole overlapping local runs and adds only known nonoverlapping runs; replacement remains explicit. No microphone, recording upload, browser-profile access or network writes.

researchBoundaries.guidedListening: A compact predict/listen/check/compare routine is a design inference from broader guided-listening work, rather than a reproduction of a semester classroom intervention.
researchBoundaries.retrievalAndSpacing: The evidence supports testing and distributed practice in studied settings; it does not establish an optimal five/ten-minute route or one-day interval for this app.
researchBoundaries.transfer: A changed-detail response asks for transfer, but passing the software workflow does not demonstrate improved spontaneous Italian conversation.
researchBoundaries.speech: No automatic pronunciation or fluency grading and no microphone collection are part of this route.

verification.isolation: Owned standalone Chromium, fresh disposable contexts and synthetic progress/backups only. No shared CDP, browser profile or real learner records.
verification.fullRunNote: The six core workflows passed before the final budget-only visual change. They were not needlessly repeated after that styling change.

verifiedWorkflows.name: Five-minute optional Today route
verifiedWorkflows.observed: Hidden transcript/model; saved prediction and selected answer survive reload. A first wrong gist stays wrong and readonly after feedback. Later text/model views do not rewrite it. Retell drafting/support/self-check completion persist and leave ordinary plan/progress unchanged.

verifiedWorkflows.name: Ten-minute supported comprehension
verifiedWorkflows.observed: Transcript support persists through reload, correct gist remains supported and wrong detail remains its first result. Retell edits clear checks; model-use evidence persists. The weekly card shows one completed run, one gist, one detail, zero correct without text support, two supported first responses and zero completed transfers.

verifiedWorkflows.name: Later-day fresh response
verifiedWorkflows.observed: A return query creates no response before the due date. On the next calendar date, a distinct changed-situation prompt accepts a saved draft/model view and self-check completion. Original first results, retell output and completion date remain unchanged; no improvement claim is shown.

verifiedWorkflows.name: Local backup privacy
verifiedWorkflows.observed: Actual synthetic export contains oral evidence but no audio/recording/transcript/URL fields. Selecting a file is a nonmutating preview. Merge retains the whole conflicting local first-failure run and adds a missing scene; explicit replacement uses the incoming state. A sparse version1 backup without oral data still restores and opens.

verifiedWorkflows.name: Keyboard and unavailable voice
verifiedWorkflows.observed: Voice unavailability is explained. Explicit reading records support. Keyboard checking focuses feedback; Tab reaches Continue; stage change focuses the task heading. Italian scaffolding remains available in the English interface without forcing model use.

verifiedWorkflows.name: Complementary layouts and capacity
verifiedWorkflows.observed: The three-scene catalogue fits the sampled layouts. A synthetic 200-run history preserves records and shows export guidance while existing work remains available.

verification.horizontalOverflow: None in the nine full-workflow screenshot samples or two final budget samples.
verification.speechVerification: One Italian device-voice intent was observed using a deterministic browser stub; a separate unavailable-voice case verified supported reading. No actual audio quality, pronunciation or comprehension was measured.
verification.visualReview: Viewed Italian phone completion and weekly evidence, Italian desktop catalogue, and final English320 selected-five/selected-ten screenshots. The final selected button is visibly green with light text.
verification.parentIntegratedChecks: Parent reported 245 full tests, typecheck, lint and build passed before full workflow QA; the final style-only build also passed typecheck/lint/build.

implementationReview.content: Independently read all three original bilingual scenes, gist/detail options and answer witnesses, retell models/rubrics and later-day fresh prompts. No blocking language, consistency or answer-leak issue found.
implementationReview.evidence: First checked gist/detail choices are readonly. Correct-answer feedback permits continued practice but never rewrites the first response. Text/model support is monotone within its task and does not retroactively change an earlier unaided response.
implementationReview.accessibility: Prebuild review raised feedback focus and Italian-scaffold concerns. The parent focused checked feedback using stable primitive identities, retained transcript-trigger focus after reveal, and kept an Italian frame available in both interface languages.
implementationReview.selectedBudget: A later visual review found a global secondary-button rule hiding the selected budget treatment. The parent switched the selected button to the established primary style; the final targeted check measured distinct foreground/background styles and readable contrast for both selections.

weeklyIntegration.evidence: Known scene runs only: actual dated first gist/detail responses, recorded text support, completed runs with self-checked retelling, and fresh self-checked responses completed on a strictly later calendar day.
weeklyIntegration.boundaries: Drafts and support views do not become completions. Unknown identities and future events are excluded. The existing report fallback and recommendations are unchanged.
weeklyIntegration.labels: The bilingual card separates comprehension choices from self-assessed retelling/transfer and explicitly avoids listening-ability, speaking-improvement or proficiency claims.

limitations: Synthetic workflows verify the stated software behavior; they do not establish learning gains, delayed retention or spontaneous conversation ability.
The voice API was stubbed for deterministic UI verification, so pronunciation quality, real-device voice availability and acoustic intelligibility remain untested.
The later-day task uses a new self-assessed response, not a fresh automatically graded listening test.
All exports, imports and replacements used disposable synthetic backups. No real learner data, microphone recordings or source audio were accessed.
The 200-run capacity guidance was checked in the browser. Over-capacity backup union rejection has separate model/merge regression coverage.
